description: Strategies confirmed to reproducibly exceed the pooled full-window backtest's 3600s budget - not an OOM kill (`resource_inconclusive`), not a crash, just too slow to finish 8 pairs over 6.5 years inside the fixed timeout. The 3600s budget is a hard limit, not tuned per strategy (see PIPELINE.md Stage 7). A strategy listed here is excluded from `regime/full_backtest.py`'s automatic retry so it does not re-burn a full hour every container pass; it stays admitted (`E1_expanded`) and simply has no Stage-9 pooled-performance figure. Confirmation bar: at least two independent timeout attempts at exactly the 3600s ceiling, with no other failure mode (no exception, no OOM signature) in between.

SuperHV27.why: Two independent attempts (2026-09-07, 2026-09-08) both ran to exactly the 3600s ceiling with no exception and no OOM signature - not a resource_inconclusive case. The compat shims (repair/compat_signature.py: legacy_bid_ask_strategy_price_side, synthetic_orderbook_from_last_close) fixed the crash this strategy used to hit; per-pair caching keeps the orderbook shim's DataProvider.get_pair_dataframe() call from being called on every confirm_trade_entry, but the strategy still calls confirm_trade_entry on every signal across 8 pairs and 6.5 years, and that remaining per-trade cost alone exceeds the budget.

Schism.why: Two independent attempts (2026-09-07, 2026-09-08) both ran to exactly the 3600s ceiling with no exception and no OOM signature - not a resource_inconclusive case. Same PeetCrypto_freqtrade-stuff family and orderbook-shim dependency as SuperHV27; the underlying per-trade cost of the synthetic orderbook lookup accumulates past the budget over the full pooled window.

Hacklemore.why: Two independent attempts (2026-09-07, 2026-09-08) both ran to exactly the 3600s ceiling with no exception and no OOM signature - not a resource_inconclusive case.

Hacklemore3.why: Two independent attempts (2026-09-07, 2026-09-08) both ran to exactly the 3600s ceiling with no exception and no OOM signature - not a resource_inconclusive case. This is the strategy the synthetic-orderbook compat shim was built for (repair/compat_signature.py); the shim fixed the KeyError crash, but the same remaining per-trade orderbook-lookup cost that limits SuperHV27/Schism applies here too.

NowoIchimoku5mV2.why: Three independent attempts (2026-09-07, 2026-09-08 x2) all ran to exactly the 3600s ceiling with no exception and no OOM signature - not a resource_inconclusive case.

AlexBandSniperV10AINoBias.why: Two independent attempts (pooled w1 and solo retry, same day) both ran to exactly the 3600s ceiling with no exception and no OOM signature - not a resource_inconclusive case. This is the audit-authored lookahead-fix derivative of AlexBandSniperV10AI: the vectorized ML-entry fix (populate_entry_trend) now runs the 16-feature RandomForest predict_proba computation and the pivot-window scan over every qualifying row across 8 pairs and 6.5 years, instead of only ever the original's single last row, so the pooled window's per-candle cost is materially higher than the un-fixed strategy's.
